subject.title: [security] Artifact publish symlink TOCTOU can upload files outside the bundle

question: Should maintainers promote a narrow security fix now for the artifact publish TOCTOU, and should it bind upload reads to validated file objects or revalidate each backend path immediately before use?
rationale: The source-level boundary gap is clear, but disclosure handling and the exact fail-closed artifact contract are security-sensitive maintainer decisions before automation should change the publish path.

options.title: Promote narrow security fix
options.body: Treat this as in-scope artifact-boundary hardening and repair broker, S3/R2, Cloudflare, and manifest paths with a focused regression test.

options.title: Defer as defense in depth
options.body: Keep the report open but do not schedule repair until maintainers decide the local-writer race is worth addressing in this workflow.

options.title: Fold into broader artifact redesign
options.body: Use this issue as input to a larger artifact API or storage refactor if maintainers want a different file identity model.

recommendation.title: Promote narrow security fix
recommendation.body: Treat this as in-scope artifact-boundary hardening and repair broker, S3/R2, Cloudflare, and manifest paths with a focused regression test.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the recent artifact publish hardening and most current history for the affected CLI path.
